summary: Explore and develop distinct concept mechanisms under constraints, then select by declared criteria without confusing invention with fact.
triggers: develop competing concepts for a product, game, story, or experience
find different mechanisms for a constrained design brief
use a distant analogy to rethink an experience
compare concept directions before committing to one
antiTriggers: fact research without a concept decision
request to present invented events as factual canon
fixed single-direction brief with no material uncertainty to explore
